items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did he have Jimmy Harrison at one time? [INTERVIEWEE] He had everybody.

ctx.x: we came back, he didn't have no more work! But we was rehearsing every day. He loved to rehearse, he loved to hear his band, and stand on the corner and talk about how great a band he has. And he'd tell you about all the men in the band, this-that-and-the-other... He didn't have nothin' but the best men.
Did he have Jimmy Harrison at one time?

He had everybody. He had everybody. He damn near had Duke Ellington! Well, he could have got Duke, too, because Duke wasn't doin' nothin'. Duke wasn't doin' nothin' but standing at a bar waiting for a live one to come in. And Duke, he went to work... Duke went to work for Billy Cain's club on Eighth Avenue, a little joint, you know. Then after that, Duke left town and went up to New England, barnstorming through New England. They stayed up there all summer. When they come back from that, then they went in the…
